messages:
nightly-bot: nightly eval alert: rdx-1.2-quant failing long_sessions_v3. failure_rate=12.3% vs baseline 1.1%. attaching sample dumps.

maya: noticed many outputs cut off mid-instruction — ends like '... please then' repeatedly.

chetan: any common token offset when it cuts? looks like truncation?

maya: not truncation by input size. inputs are 8k, outputs stop ~7.8k tokens. kv_slots look full but gen stops early.

liam: quick check: grep of dumps shows last_emitted token around 7800 for many sessions. repro command i ran: ```./eval_longctx.py --model rdx-1.2-quant --prompts long_sessions_v3 --dump-kv --seed 42```

eva: dequant (rdx-1.2-fp16) doesn't reproduce. points to quant path. maybe stop detection math changed.

chetan: can we see the session kv meta around cutoff?

maya: paste from sess_0x9f3a: ```SESSION ID: sess_0x9f3a
input_len=8192 tokens
kv_slots_used=4096
tok_emitted=7801
last_emitted='please then'
kv_tail_meta: [slot=4090 seq=12457, slot=4091 seq=12458, slot=4092 seq=12459]
last_attention_win=256```

liam: seqnums contiguous, so not a wrap. runtime log shows: ```EPOCH: 2024-11-02T03:12:12Z WARN inference/runtime.cpp: KV_PAIR_MISMATCH detected for model rdx-1.2-quant
EPOCH: 2024-11-02T03:12:12Z INFO runtime/stop_criteria.cpp: early_termination_triggered token_id=50256```

eva: early_termination_triggered is suspicious — stop_criteria had edits in last quant PR.

chetan: i'll bisect quant branch. script: ```git bisect start
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good origin/main~10
./run_short_repro.sh```

maya: also please include a run with kv_prefetch off to rule prefetch interaction.

chetan: yep. @liam can you try `--no-prefetch --batch-size=1` deterministic reproduce?

liam: running now. if i get it, i'll collect strace and env.

ops: note — dedicated pool got quant rollout last night. rollback is possible but needs approval. holding for triage.

maya: locally, quant stops in ~65% of cases. dequant always completes.

eva: points to quant causing spurious eos spike. maybe folding changed eos bias.

chetan: bisect narrowed to commit 8e3f7a4 touching stop_criteria and quantize.cc kernel selection. running focused tests.

liam: `--no-prefetch` still fails, so prefetch unlikely.

maya: next steps: @chetan run full bisect + candidate revert, @eva write unit test that emulates quantized logits to trigger stop_criteria, @liam capture runtime trace/core on failure.

eva: starting unit test: synthetic quantized logits + eos scoring to reproduce early termination.

chetan: isolated test failing. root cause: int8 softmax kernel applies right-shift accumulator -> underflow on long sequences -> occasional eos spike.

maya: mitigation options? raise eos threshold on quant models?

eva: short-term patch: disable stop_criteria until emitted_token_count > 8000 for longctx jobs and add verbose logging. unsafe but prevents regressions for customers.

ops: temporary mitigation approved for nightly and dedicated pools. will coordinate rollback after proper fix.

liam: i'll produce a reproducible artifact and run an extended nightly after mitigation is in.

maya: i'll update incident doc and ping product for potential hotfix release.

nightly-bot: mitigation deployed to nightly runners at 03:58 UTC. monitoring 6h. :thumbsup:
